sources.title: Flash temperature in sliding contacts: Comparing theory with experiments
sources.author: B. N. J. Persson
sources.access: publisher full HTML and arXiv v1 PDF; equations 19-23 and Appendix checked
limitations: comparison experiment is steel on steel, not artificial firn

published pressure-weighted coefficient 0.352 differs from independently integrated 0.3551658 by about 0.9%; unresolved; not used to evaluate peaks

sources.title: Tribological Performance of Biodegradable Polymers: Comparative Study of PLA, PBS, PHBV and CAB

sources.title: How to glide well on wet snow? Can roughness and hydrophobicity lower friction of polymers on snow?
sources.access: original journal PDF; methods and results text read
limitations: 0.1 m/s, 53.3 N on snow in cold chamber
not wet warm polymer-grain bed or winter anchoring test
no friction coefficient transferred into this cycle model

sources.title: Scalable Preparation of Liquid Infused Coatings for Lubrication of 10^3 m2 Dry Ski Slopes
